vars.label: Vehicle-kilometres a day (HPMS)
vars.ref: FHWA Highway Performance Monitoring System, Puerto Rico full join, data year 2025 (geo.dot.gov, HPMS_FULL_PR_2025)
vars.definition: The vehicle-kilometres driven on an average day on the municipio's public roads: each road section's annual average daily traffic times its length, added up. Local streets are included with the traffic the Department of Transportation and Public Works estimates for them; ramps are left out.

vars.label: Vehicle-kilometres a day per resident (HPMS)
vars.ref: FHWA Highway Performance Monitoring System, Puerto Rico full join, data year 2025 (geo.dot.gov, HPMS_FULL_PR_2025)
vars.definition: The daily vehicle-kilometres on the municipio's roads over its residents in the 2020 Census. It counts every vehicle on those roads, also those of people who live elsewhere, so it is high where through traffic is heavy.

vars.label: Arterials and major collectors, km (HPMS)
vars.ref: FHWA Highway Performance Monitoring System, Puerto Rico full join, data year 2025 (geo.dot.gov, HPMS_FULL_PR_2025)
vars.definition: The length of the municipio's main roads: freeways and expressways, principal and minor arterials and major collectors (functional classes 1 to 5), each road counted once.

vars.label: Busiest road, vehicles a day (HPMS)
vars.ref: FHWA Highway Performance Monitoring System, Puerto Rico full join, data year 2025 (geo.dot.gov, HPMS_FULL_PR_2025)
vars.definition: The highest annual average daily traffic on any section of the municipio's arterials and major collectors.

vars.label: Trucks, % of traffic on the main roads (HPMS)
vars.ref: FHWA Highway Performance Monitoring System, Puerto Rico full join, data year 2025 (geo.dot.gov, HPMS_FULL_PR_2025)
vars.definition: Single-unit and combination trucks as a share of all vehicles, in vehicle-kilometres, on the arterials and major collectors whose sections report trucks.

vars.label: Main roads with rough pavement, % of km measured (HPMS)
vars.ref: FHWA Highway Performance Monitoring System, Puerto Rico full join, data year 2025 (geo.dot.gov, HPMS_FULL_PR_2025)
vars.definition: The share of the measured kilometres of arterials and major collectors whose International Roughness Index is over 170 inches per mile, FHWA's threshold for poor pavement.

fhwa_hpms.name: FHWA · Highway Performance Monitoring System (HPMS), Puerto Rico full join
fhwa_hpms.note: Every road section Puerto Rico reported for 2025, with its traffic, lanes and pavement; the observatory publishes municipio figures and the main roads.

notes.what: Annual average daily traffic as Puerto Rico reports it to FHWA: counts on the main roads (of different years: each section's aadt_vd), estimates on local streets.
